input_measurement.formula: 0.01 * L / ||grad||^2 — targets 1% loss reduction per step in quadratic approximation
input_measurement.validation: Tested 5 candidates (0.1x to 10x theory) for 100 steps each; selected lowest final loss among stable, decreasing runs

input_measurement.formula: ln(2) / (max_epochs * lr) — targets 50% weight magnitude shrinkage over training budget without learning signal

input_measurement.rationale: AdamW provides per-parameter adaptive learning rates; decoupled weight decay avoids coupling regularization to gradient magnitude
Full batch gives exact gradient; dataset fits in memory
With full-batch training, dropout adds noise to an already exact gradient; weight decay is the appropriate regularization for this regime

derivation.norm_first: Pre-LN for gradient stability with deep residual paths
derivation.pooling: Mean over 3 positions — all inputs (a, b, p) contribute equally to the answer

input_measurement.min_residue_appearances: At 50%, each residue appears ~p/2 times: min 2 for p=5
